reuse.why: Adds the guard to the existing linkBankSyncAccount that every provider-specific link handler already delegates to.

duplication.why: One query and one throw, placed once; no per-provider copies.

placement.why: The guard sits at the start of the shared link routine in accounts/app.ts, before any bank, account or sync side effect.

scope.why: Only the guard and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Clear and small; the inline SQL with 'id IS NOT ?' is slightly terse but readable and documented by the tests.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared linkBankSyncAccount path and db.first like the surrounding code.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount, used by all five *-accounts-link handlers.
